ownership.quote: Datalayer (Datalayer Profile) is currently an unfunded company and has not raised any external seed or venture capital funding. Status: Bootstrapped / Unfunded

stage.quote: Datalayer has not raised any funding yet.
stage.note: Per Tracxn (third-party estimator), Datalayer.io (founded by Eric Charles, Brussels) is bootstrapped/unfunded. Not to be confused with the unrelated Web3/blockchain startup also named 'Datalayer' (datalayer.co) that closed a $500K pre-seed in June 2024 led by GBV Capital and NxGen — that is a different company with a different domain and business (Layer-1 blockchain), not this cloud/agent-runtime provider.

note: Datalayer.io is a small, apparently bootstrapped/unfunded company founded by Eric Charles (Jupyter open-source contributor), originally focused on collaborative Jupyter notebooks (founded ~2013/2021 per different sources) and now pivoting to a 'Managed Agents' platform for agentic data analysis, including on-demand runtime environments sold via Free/Team/Enterprise plans. No accelerator, priced VC round, or revenue figures were found. Caution: search results are dominated by an unrelated crypto project also called 'Datalayer' (Layer-1 blockchain, domain datalayer.co, $500K pre-seed June 2024 led by GBV Capital/NxGen) — that funding does NOT belong to this provider.
